Schaal has written oral histories of online travel, Booking.com and short-term rentals. AI has shifted the engineering bottleneck from code-writing to cross-team collaboration and code review. Booking.com's CTO advises focusing on internal AI enhancements rather than just creating customer-facing tools. Scalability and reliability of systems are crucial for Booking.com to maintain its position and reduce friction in travel. Summary Booking.com's Interim CTO, Vipul Hingne, explained at the Skift Data + AI Summit that while AI now allows code to be written rapidly, the new bottleneck is effective teamwork and cross-team communication. He cautioned that companies should prioritize AI-driven internal improvements over flashy consumer tools, as these can deliver more meaningful enhancements. To stay competitive, Booking.com must ensure its systems remain highly scalable and reliable, as any failure could create friction in the travel experience.
title: Booking.com CTO: The New Bottleneck Is Teamwork
